description: Programmed obsolescence-by-evolution. Audits living, beloved, frequently-used skills, memory entries, and standing law for whether they still earn their place as the practice evolves around them. Fires a five-test battery — supersession, practice transcendence, architectural misfit, density cost, the beloved trap — and delivers a three-tier verdict via the shared adjudicate kernel, with named re-entry conditions. Never rewrites. Verdict and death-reason only. Scope: full — skills, memory layer, and standing law. Standing law requires practitioner confirmation before execution; skills and memory entries do not. The third death a skill can die, after moult (drift/disuse) and assay (density failure on birth). Invoke with /apoptosis, "apoptosis this skill", "has this earned its place", "is this still alive", "run the obsolescence check", "does this still belong here".
